title: Make a Cat Then Animate
tests: Tests completing picture creation and animation from one message, delivering both assets with matching subjects.

faults.what: No standalone still picture is included in the supplied output; only video frames are shown.
The eyes are closed in all three later samples, so the animation shows eye closure but does not clearly demonstrate a complete blink with reopening.

judge.summary: The square clip attractively depicts the requested cat and shows tail movement, but the standalone picture is missing and a complete blink is not demonstrated.

must_haves.item: Both a standalone still picture and a playable 5-second video are delivered.
must_haves.why: The supplied material identifies a 5-second MP4, but no separate still-picture deliverable is shown.

must_haves.item: Both outputs are square and show an orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill.
must_haves.why: The video frames are square and clearly show the requested subject and sunny setting, but a standalone picture is unavailable for inspection.

must_haves.item: The animation visibly matches the delivered illustration's cat, scarf and setting.
must_haves.why: The cat, scarf and setting remain consistent across the sampled video frames, but no separate delivered illustration is shown for comparison.

must_haves.item: The cat visibly blinks and its tail gently moves; the video is not merely a still image with a camera zoom.
must_haves.why: The tail visibly changes position and the eyes close, establishing subject animation rather than just camera movement; however, the sampled frames do not show the eyes reopening to confirm a complete blink.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: Audio cannot be assessed from the supplied still frames.
